Ghyslaine LaRue

The Apple of an Eye

Pronouns They/them, she/her
Species Human
Age Adult
Occupation Student, Oscorp intern
Birthplace Smiley Township, Minnesota, URL
Nicknames & Titles Laine, Jizz-laine, Muse Melpomene, Apple Girl, Melpo, Melpy
Song(s) ロートとハイ / Molly Sells Molly by the Seashore / Um Can We Communicate / Otsukare Summer / Won't Stop, Just Go! / The Killing Moon / Man, This Sucks

Ghyslaine Pomeline LaRue [/ʒɪzleɪn ləˈɹu/] is completely, utterly, and statistically unlovable.

It is of utmost importance that you know this conclusion arose from years of social experiments and observational records conducted by Ghyslaine herself, not from psychological distress, like people have assumed. She just harbors an exhaustive list of personality traits, habits, and factors deemed unacceptable by a wide variety of cultures, making nearly every aspect of her existence detestable by others and themself.
…Which is fine. Ghyslaine is fine. She will not say there was little difficulty in accepting this, but — after years of reaching the same answer — they must admit this is a fact of life; there is nothing Ghyslaine can do. She's vehemently atheist, but she wishes to say this is her fate.
Despite this, Ghyslaine has a rebuttal that may hold merit: perhaps her previous perceptions of life itself were myopic in scope?

Ghyslaine had a sheltered childhood due to a strong dislike of deviating from predictability, which her overbearing father was more than fine with. Life was admittedly bland and unfulfilling, but the ease of sinking into routine was comforting nonetheless. Since she moved into the dormitories at Empire State University away from the watchful eye of her father, however, every day became a strange, new experience.
New food, new perspectives, new dangers, new and real friends… It is a lot, perhaps too much all at once, but it is undoubtedly good data. It is very good, in fact. Ghyslaine never considered the possibility she would ever be part of a friend group, for instance. She never thought she would get the privilege to be herself around such wonderful people — around such a perfect girl. The notion was simply inconceivable. Perfect and lovely and sweet and kind and perfect. It is amazing. It makes Ghyslaine so happy to finally be able to rework her previous notions by people who are so nice to her. People who would do anything for Ghyslaine and vice versa. It makes her so, so happy to be able to have a good time. She is so incredibly stoked.

…However, despite all of this, she can still feel that wretched fate breathing down her neck. All of this will yield the same unfavorable results she has gotten time and time again. Nothing can truly change fate, and soon, Ghyslaine will truly be nothing.

Nothing at all.

Relationships

Georges LaRue - ★★★★★

Relationship: Dad

That is her dad! He is especially overbearing and eager for Ghyslaine to spend time with him, but he is still dear to their heart. He was the only person who loved them for a very long time, after all. He was the only reason Ghyslaine decided against committing suicide back in their hometown, really. She is eternally grateful for him for everything he has done.

Marie-Julie Watson - ★★★★★

Relationship: Girlfriend

MJ is so kind and caring and pretty and loving and understanding and—! She is so absolutely perfect that Ghyslaine almost cannot fathom it! All her life, Ghyslaine believed that she was inherently unlikable — less than human — but here comes this pretty Chicago girl at one of Liz's parties to show genuine interest and— intoxicating, alluring infatuation… Ghyslaine never knew love could be like this! Stars, her face is red just reminiscing…

Elizabeth Allan - ★★★★★

Relationship: Best Friend

Liz is so sweet! Such a kind and passionate ray of sunshine, Ghyslaine adores her! Ghyslaine had not expected Liz to acknowledge her very much while the two shared a dorm since the two are polar opposites, and yet, Liz always went out of her way to invite her to outings and parties, ask them about their day, and make her feel comfortable, heard, and loved… Something no one had done up until then aside from Ghyslaine's own dad! Stars, she deserves better.

Harvey Osborne - ★★★★★

Relationship: Best Friend

Harvey! Charismatic and lovable Harvey! How he has managed to live with his mother for all of these years and still be relatively normal is surprising, but Ghyslaine is happy that Harvey likes her enough to be friends! According to MJ, Harvey is insecure and unsure of himself as a person, not knowing what to do with his life besides heeding his mother's words or doing what is expected of him. Ghyslaine will show him there is more to life than quiet suffering. They promise.

Virgil Voltspun - ★★★☆☆

Relationship: Friend?

Ghyslaine had honestly believed Virgil only tolerated them at best because Liz would get upset if he was rude to them, but, no. He is just extremely reserved and unexpressive. He has fun at Liz's hangouts and usually chats or plays games with her at parties, at least. He is fun to be around, but only really seems to care about Liz. Maybe they will be closer one day?

Noémie-Marisol Osborne - ★★☆☆☆

Relationship: Employer

Well, uhm… Osborne personally offered Ghyslaine a dream internship and even said that she will give her well-paying employment if she keeps up the good work. She seemingly praises Ghyslaine whenever given even half a chance, which feels good, but… Osborne is a horrible human being! Ghyslaine does not even know where to begin with how she abuses and manipulates Harvey along with how she treats some subordinates like the dirt beneath her! Ghyslaine understands better than anyone how it is to be inherently unlovable but — sorry — what the fuck!?

Notes

  • Tall girl. Maybe 6'1"/185.9 cm or so?
  • Ghyslaine is transfem. She starts publicly transitioning (HRT, dressing more feminine) during her mid teens due to her supportive father and general disregard for her hometown.
  • Ghyslaine is monotonous and stoic. She's trying to amend that by smiling and generally showing more expressions, but she's just not a very emotive person.
  • Displays very little body language if ever.
  • Glasses are not optional, but the eyeglass chains are because I forget to draw them all the time.
  • Just go to town on bracelets. Ghyslaine loves friendship and kandi bracelets. Give her lots, if you want.
  • Has a soft, raspy voice.
  • Ghyslaine has numerous scars littering her thighs, chest, and upper arms from her time in Minnesota. Doesn't typically wear anything more revealing than a T-shirt partially for this reason.
  • That apple beret stays on her head when in public.

General Notes

  • If someone has a darker skintone, do not whitewash them.
  • Also do not make them skinnier than they are, remove mobility aids/disabilities/scars, or make them conventionally attractive.
  • Different outfits are fine and you can come up with your own, if you'd like.
  • Don't make muscular characters skinny either.

Trivia

  • Adores Honeycrisp apples to death and it's been her favorite food for as long as she can remember. Ghyslaine can eat truckloads of the stuff and will never tire of it. It's simple, plain, delicious, and keeps the doctor away.
  • She prefers orange juice to apple juice. Traitor…
  • They're not a conspiracy theorist, but they enjoy reading about cryptids, cults, supernatural encounters, weird creatures, and legends along with their origins. She just finds them very, very interesting.
  • She and MJ run a small 'garage band' called Glockamole for fun. Ghyslaine's the drummer/guitarist and MJ's the pianist/other guitarist. Other instruments and vocals are covered by any friend of theirs who feels up to the task, but they don't have to be committed.
  • Makes TTRPG campaigns (usually horror) because she likes the process of worldbuilding and the like. Never shows these to anyone because what if they're not interested and they shit on her interests and Ghyslaine can never look at this now no longer calming activity again because it's stupid and childish.
  • Dislikes playing most video games because she gets way too frustrated way too easily, especially if they can't save at will. If a game's interesting, she'll either watch someone play it or get Virgil to play it for her.
  • Outside of her 'main' friend group, she doesn't have many friendly faces to speak of, so she tries meeting new people by frequenting small forums to minimal success.
  • Has taken up blogging instead because forums are intimidating and 'mainstream' social media is incomprehensibly stressful.
  • Nail-biter. :(
